history.content: Hi, my phone has no signal at all—no calls, no internet, and I can't send picture messages. It just shows no service.

I can help you troubleshoot this issue. To get started, I’ll need to identify your account. Could you please provide one of the following:

- The phone number associated with your account
- Your customer ID
- Your full name and date of birth

Once I have this information, I can check your account and assist you further.
My name is Sofia Martinez and my phone number is +1-617-555-0148.

Your line is currently suspended, which is why you have no service for calls, internet, or picture messages. However, I see that all your recent bills are paid, and your contract is still active.

Since your bills are paid and your contract is valid, I can resume your line to restore your service. After I do this, you will need to reboot your phone to regain service.

Would you like me to proceed and resume your line now?
Yes, please go ahead and resume my line. Let me know when I should restart my phone.

Your line has been resumed and is now active. Please restart your phone now to restore your service for calls, internet, and picture messages.

If you still experience any issues after restarting, let me know and I can help you further.

history.content: I restarted my phone as you asked, but I still have no signal—there are no bars and it still says no service.

Thank you for letting me know. Since your line is now active but you still have no signal, let's troubleshoot your phone's connectivity.

Could you please check your phone’s status bar and let me know if you see any of the following:
- Airplane mode icon
- SIM card error or missing SIM message
- Any signal bars at all (even if they are empty)
- Any other unusual icons

If you’re not sure, just describe what you see at the top of your phone’s screen. This will help me guide you through the next steps.
After restarting, my phone now shows excellent signal bars, 5G, data enabled, and says it's connected to Chestnut-5G at 87% battery. What should I try next to make sure everything works?

That’s great news! Your phone now shows excellent signal, 5G connectivity, and data is enabled, which means your service has been restored.

To make sure everything is working, please try the following:
1. Make a phone call to confirm voice service.
2. Open a website or app (with Wi-Fi turned off) to confirm mobile data works.
3. Send a picture message (MMS) to confirm multimedia messaging is working.

If all of these work, your service is fully restored. If you encounter any issues with calls, internet, or picture messages, let me know which one isn’t working and I’ll help you troubleshoot further.
I just tried sending a picture message and it worked! Calls and internet are also working fine. Everything seems back to normal now.

That’s excellent to hear! Your service is fully restored, and all features—calls, internet, and picture messaging—are working as expected.

If you have any other questions or need assistance in the future, feel free to reach out. Have a great day!
